task_policy.pull_cube: At t4 after two unknown ACKs, if the complete setpoint common-action is UNAUTHORIZED or the certified max(position/0.05m, rotation/0.05rad) is below 0.75, query the private target once BEFORE action; otherwise continue with common robust command and allow exactly one later query if a future common action refuses.
task_policy.stack_cube: At t4 after two unknown ACKs, always query the private target exactly once if episode still alive.
task_policy.task_ID_usage: Explicit task-conditioned heuristic (NOT task-blind, NOT learned general value-of-information estimator). The choice is fixed before new trials. Source policy and controller models unchanged.
